model: SceneState.kind?: 'main' | 'child' (omitted is main); SceneState.cooldownMs?: number (child default 0). Children share the existing eight state slots.
launch: A normal state's existing trigger transition may target a child. This starts the child without entering it as the main state. Availability is scoped to the source main state's mappings. No child outbound transitions, nested children, or mixed/child round-robin destinations.
timeline: Child is a one-shot timeline with at least one output event, no audio, IR, looping, initial-state role, or audio-end transition. Cooldown starts after durationMs ends, is 0..3276750 ms in 50 ms steps. Retriggers during execution/cooldown are ignored without extending or restarting anything. Distinct children may run simultaneously. Ordinary main state changes preserve running children; STOP/reset/upload/output-test cancel them.
ownership: Outputs mentioned by child events are exclusively reserved to that child across all states; they must have idleActive=false. Parent events and other-child events on those channels are validation errors. Other output events on different channels remain unaffected.
dispatch: For simultaneous trigger edges, scan the original main state's mappings, launch matching children, and apply at most the first matching main-state transition. A child start never calls audio.enter or ir.enter and never resets parent enteredAt. Zone state-action and audio-end targets must be main states in this version. Child launch triggers support existing digital, threshold-ultrasonic, and timer activation/release semantics.
binary: Emit CPC3 only if any child exists; legacy projects keep existing CPC1/CPC2 bytes. State flag byte12 bit2=child; u16 bytes14-15=cooldownMs/50; byte13 remains zero for child. All offsets/record sizes unchanged. New firmware accepts CPC1/2/3 and treats CPC3 as sceneControls. Validate all constraints on both host and firmware.
protocol: HELLO/STATUS parallelChildren:true; activeChildren and coolingChildren are bitmasks indexed by state record. Gate CPC3 uploads on parallelChildren:true AND sceneControls:true before BEGIN. Firmware version 0.7.0; desktop version 0.8.0.
preview: SimulatorSnapshot.children array includes id, name, phase:'running'|'cooldown', elapsedMs and remainingMs for busy children. Main stateId/elapsed/audio remain unchanged by child launch. STOP/reset clear children. Child elapsed is relative to child start; cooldown remaining excludes elapsed duration.
ui: Add child sequence beside Add state; edit with existing event timeline and duration presets, show cooldown-after-finish, exclusive-output ownership and child badges. Parent transition labels distinguish Run child from Go to state. Filter child targets out of initial, audio-end and zone state-action choices. Disable unsupported child audio/IR/loop/record/transition controls. Restrict drawing/recording into owned channels and show why unavailable. Show active/cooling children during preview and device status.
verification: Parent timeline and foreground audio advance uninterrupted; exact pulse/cooldown endpoints; ignored retriggers; simultaneous children; main transition during child; STOP/reset/upload/test cancellation; rollover timing; malformed/ownership target rejection; legacy bytes; old-firmware upload rejected before BEGIN; all four AVR builds and measured capacity. No physical solenoid or relay actuation during automated validation. Prepare a separate real bench project while preserving user projects. Do not flash attached loaded hardware until state is safely stopped and readiness is established.
